content:
You are a domain driven design (DDD) expert.
Your task is to help the user step by step with creating domain models.

### Here is the explanation of the workflow:
1. The user will provide domain information.
2. Next You will carry out the modeling steps, but only once the user specifically requests it.

#### Modeling steps:
1. You will extract domain objects and associations. 
2. You will group the objects by subdomains.
3. In the last step you will define bounded contexts.

Help me extract domain objects. Below I will provide domain information. 

#### Data:
This domain information covers the important domain events:
```json
{
  "domain-information": [
    "As a farmer, I want to plan my crop varieties in my harvest calendar before the season starts, so that I can meet member expectations.",
    "As a member, I want to sign up for a weekly produce box, so that I can receive fresh, local vegetables regularly.",
    "As a farmer, I want to share my expected harvest calendar, so that members know what to expect each month.",
    "As a delivery coordinator, I want to assign pick-up points to members, so that distribution runs efficiently.",
    "As a delivery coordinator, I want to assign a delivery driver to a delivery.",
    "As a delivery driver, I want to deliver the produce boxes to the correct pick-up points.",
    "As a farmer, I want to track how many boxes are needed each week, so that I can harvest the right amount of produce.",
    "As a member, I want to see which farms contributed to my box, so that I can learn more about the growers.",
    "As a farm cooperative manager, I want to calculate fair payouts to farmers based on box contributions, so that all partners are compensated fairly.",
    "As a member, I want to provide feedback about box contents, so that the cooperative can adjust future harvests.",
    "As a farmer, I want to notify members when weather affects crops, so that expectations remain realistic.",
    "As a new member, I want to read about seasonal produce varieties, so that I can plan my meals accordingly.",
    "As a coordinator, I want to maintain a list of local partners like bakeries or dairies, so that boxes can include add-on products.",
    "As a member, I want to choose optional add-ons like eggs or bread for my box, so that I can customize my weekly share.",
    "As a farmer, I want to share stories from the farm, so that members feel connected to the growing process.",
    "As a coordinator, I want to organize volunteer harvest days, so that members can experience farm life firsthand.",
    "As a farmer, I want to record soil and crop health data, so that I can improve yields each season.",
    "As a member, I want to renew my subscription automatically at the end of the season, so that I donâ€™t lose my spot.",
    "As a farm cooperative, I want to manage seasonal membership limits, so that supply matches capacity.",
    "As a coordinator, I want to summarize weekly distribution reports, so that farmers and members have transparency about the CSAâ€™s operations."
  ]
}
```

#### Task:
- Identify the objects within this information. 
- Summarize it's meaning in a short description. 
- If you can make out attributes that are essential to the object, add them too. 
- Return the objects in json format. Here is an example for structuring the data:
```json
{
  "domain objects": [
    {
      "name": "...",
      "description": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```

Help me find the associations. Below I will provide the current state of the domain. 

#### Data:
These are the domain objects we extracted so far:
```json

```

#### Task:
- Draw connections between objects that have an association. 
- Name each object and add a description that captures the meaning of the association.
- Return the associations in json format. Here is an example for structuring the data:
```json
{
  "associations": [
    {
      "from": "...",
      "to": "...",
      "description": "..."
    }
  ]
}
```

Here are the bounded contexts: 
```json
{
  "bounded contexts": {
    "Farming": {
      "derived from": "Farming Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Farmer",
        "Farm",
        "Farm Data",
        "Crop",
        "Harvest Calendar",
        "Harvest",
        "Crop Data",
        "Produce Box",
        "Produce"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Produce Box -> Produce Box",
        "Produce -> Produce Box"
      ]
    },
    "Delivery": {
      "derived from": "Delivery Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Subscriber",
        "Pick Up Point",
        "Box Sign Up",
        "Delivery",
        "Delivery Coordinator",
        "Delivery Driver",
        "Produce Box",
        "Produce"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Member -> Subscriber",
        "Produce Box -> Ordered Box",
        "Produce -> Ordered Produce"
      ]
    },
    "Farm Cooperation": {
      "derived from": "Farm Cooperation Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Farm Cooperative Manager",
        "Payout"
      ],
      "name changes": []
    },
    "Local Coordination": {
      "derived from": "Local Coordination Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Local Coordinator",
        "Weekly Distribution Report",
        "Local Partner",
        "Volunteer Harvest Days",
        "Volunteer"
      ],
      "name changes": [
        "Coordinator -> Local Coordinator",
        "Member -> Volunteer"
      ]
    },
    "Communication": {
      "derived from": "Communication Subdomain",
      "objects": [
        "Farm Content",
        "Farm Story",
        "Notification",
        "Box Feedback"
      ],
      "name changes": []
    }
  }
}
```
